description: Query a Fort Worth Open Data dataset by resource_id (from datasets). where is an ArcGIS SQL filter (e.g. "Permit_Type = 'Building'"), select a comma list of field names, order a field with optional DESC, group one field to count rows per value (returns n). Returns matching rows as JSON.

group.description: One field name: returns the row count per value as n.

order.description: Field with optional DESC, e.g. "Permit_No DESC".

select.description: Comma list of field names to return, e.g. "Permit_No, Permit_Type". Default: all.

where.description: ArcGIS SQL where filter, e.g. "Permit_Type = 'Building'". Default: all rows.

name: data_fortworth_query
title: Data Fortworth Query
